name: shot
purpose: The camera of a scene: a named shot. The scene finds the framing, and it moves to the newest shot that shows, with easing.
binds: a state key with the shot name (optional)

name.doc: wide, high, side, front, top or close:<body id>; side faces the x-y plane, front the z-y plane, top the x-z plane; high looks down at the x-z plane at an angle of 40 degrees

turn.doc: degrees that the camera goes round the picture from the named shot; 90 is a quarter of the way round

tilt.doc: degrees that the camera goes up from the named shot

bind.doc: a state key that holds the shot name; the board's cam operation sets it

step.doc: the shot starts at this step of the scene
